Evidence/CLM-036
Evidence record

A reconstruction programme is documented; the exact CBY formula is not

What does this evidence establish?

IMF documents a 2024–2025 external-sector statistical reconstruction effort with CBY-Aden, including a demographic-behavioural personal-transfer model where informal-channel data were limited. This establishes method context, not the exact formula or scope used for every remittance value in the CBY-Aden Annual Report 2025.

What does it measure?

This record describes the documented work of the IMF with the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) in 2024–2025 to reconstruct external-sector statistics, including a model of personal transfers; it reports no value.

Who or what does it apply to?

The IMF's analytical framework for external-sector statistics for areas under the internationally recognized government; component scopes and source methods vary

When was it measured or observed?

2014–2025 reconstruction / 2025–26 publication cycle

How current is it?

The reconstruction work took place in 2024–2025, covers 2014 to 2025 and was documented in IMF publications of 2025–2026. The record describes method rather than a value and does not describe later method work unless newer documentation is published.

What this evidence does not establish

The public evidence does not establish the exact formula behind the values in the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) Annual Report 2025, or that CBY-Aden and IMF levels share the same scope.

Limits of the measure

The reconstruction work is documented; a line-by-line crosswalk to the CBY 2025 annual report is not public.

How was it produced?

IMF documents: a D4D-II capacity-development progress report and the statistical annex of the IMF 2025 Article IV consultation.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page.
